#bot.Expression.veryhappy
Staff member: I counted, everyone is still in their seats. Lucky!
You: …
Bot: How was that? Did you enjoy the ride?
You: No I didn’t! I was scared for my life!
Bot: You got pranked! There wasn’t any belt malfunction! 
You: What?
Bot: That story I told you before was also manufactured. Amusement park staff is just hyping this ride to be more than it actually is to give people a ride they won’t ever forget!
You: Well, they succeeded…
Bot: Uwah! Even your hands are shaking!
You: You got me good, I will have my revenge!
Bot: I will be waiting!
You: I can barely stand…{{wi}} let’s go home…
Bot: Sure!
